title: CIA telepathy drawing tests at SRI
place_text: Stanford Research Institute, Palo Alto; Langley, Virginia

tellings.quote: So the CIA took me to Stanford Research Institute. drawings were done miles away and I had to receive those drawings telepathically.

plain: In the 1970s the CIA tested whether a man could receive drawings by telepathy, at the Stanford Research Institute (SRI), a research centre in Palo Alto, California. The man tested was Uri Geller, the Israeli-born performer famous for his claimed psychic feats, and he tells it on the show as his own experience: "the CIA took me to Stanford Research Institute," where drawings were made "miles away" and he had to pick them up with his mind. It is part of the same story as the government's psychic spying programme that began at SRI, and if true it shows the CIA took telepathy seriously enough to test it.
